description: This file contains functions for rendering XML documentation comments from Markdown nodes, including handling of special nodes, code blocks, and links, specifically for .NET XML documentation generation.

methods.name: renderXmlDoc
methods.description: Generates XML documentation comments from Markdown nodes, wrapping summary and remarks sections.

methods.name: _innerRenderNodes
methods.description: Processes Markdown nodes to produce summary and remarks sections with proper formatting.

methods.name: _wrapCode
methods.description: Escapes and formats code lines for XML documentation.

methods.name: _wrapInNode
methods.description: Wraps content in specified XML tags and appends to target array.

methods.name: _wrapAndEscape
methods.description: Converts Markdown node text into formatted lines with link and code escaping, respecting max column width.

methods.name: _nodeShouldBeIgnored
methods.description: Determines if a Markdown node should be ignored based on its content.

methods.name: renderTextOnly
methods.description: Returns the textual summary of Markdown nodes without XML formatting.
